items.title: Glenn Schumann Named Florida State Head Coach
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – Renowned defensive coordinator Glenn Schumann has been named Florida State's head football coach, it was announced Monday.

items.title: Seminoles Fall to NC State
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – The Florida State football team (5-6, 3-5 ACC) fell to NC State (5-6, 3-4 ACC) 28-10 on Saturday afternoon inside Doak Campbell Stadium.

items.title: Homecoming and Seminole Heritage Game Activations
Seminoles Take Down Pitt for Second Straight Road Win
items.summary: PITTSBURGH – The Florida State football team (5-5, 3-4 ACC) defeated Pitt (6-4, 3-4 ACC) 16-10 Friday night at Acrisure Stadium, earning its second consecutive road win.

items.title: Thomas, Chaplin Named ACC Players of the Week
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – 5th Year left tackle Xavier Chaplin and freshman running back Amari Thomas earned ACC Player of the Week recognition Monday after helping lead FSU to a 31-24 victory at Boston College.

items.title: FSU vs. NC State Set for 3:30 PM on November 21
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – Florida State will host NC State on Nov. 21 at 3:30 PM, it was announced Monday. The game will air on ACC Network from Doak Campbell Stadium.

items.title: Seminoles Battle Past Boston College for Road Victory
items.summary: CHESTNUT HILL, Mass. – The Florida State football team (4-5, 2-4 ACC) defeated Boston College (4-5, 2-4 ACC) 31-24 on Saturday afternoon at Alumni Stadium.

items.title: Florida State Makes Football Leadership Change
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. — Florida State University President Richard McCullough informed head football coach Mike Norvell Sunday afternoon that FSU is making a change in the leadership of its football program, effective immediately. FSU Athletics Hall of Fame member Rick Stockstill has been named interim head coach.

items.title: Seminoles Fall to Clemson

items.title: Florida State Set to Honor Peter Warrick With Oct. 31 NFF Hall of Fame On-Campus Salute
items.summary: IRVING, Texas (Oct. 26, 2026) – Florida State and the National Football Foundation (NFF) & College Hall of Fame announced today that they will jointly honor 2026 NFF College Football Hall of Fame electee Peter Warrick with an NFF Hall of Fame On-Campus Salute, presented by Fidelity Investments.
